patterns.name: Reporting fields assumed uniform across answer types
patterns.generalFixRule: Tie each required reporting field to the answer types that return it.
patterns.fix: v2: per-type field list verified against the API reference.

patterns.name: Skip rule boundary drawn by reading effort instead of mechanism
patterns.generalFixRule: Define exclusions by whether a deterministic mechanism decides the fact, and keep examples consistent with the rule.
patterns.fix: v4 (user direction): exclude only mechanism-decided facts; example changed to a meaning question.

patterns.name: Provenance of relayed mechanism output
patterns.generalFixRule: Binary rule: unless you ran it, it is not reproduced; read counts directly; assert only what the output shows when the conclusion relies on it.
patterns.fix: v9/v11/v14/v17 converging wording; structural rewrite at v9.

patterns.name: Inspection and send not separated
patterns.generalFixRule: When prose ordering keeps being violated and the example contradicts it, enforce the order mechanically.
patterns.fix: v19: helper requires --inspect stamp matching the file hash (exit 4) and refuses credential patterns (exit 5); example rewritten as three calls.

patterns.name: Assumptions folded into one criteria set degrade judgments
patterns.generalFixRule: One reading per assertion; split whenever readings could change the answer.

patterns.name: Agent findings leaking into criteria
patterns.generalFixRule: Describe outcomes symmetrically; examples in criteria only from the claim being checked.

patterns.name: Assumption vs finding boundary
patterns.generalFixRule: Meaning assumptions allowed when the answer depends on them; observed outcomes never; give a contrasting example pair.

patterns.name: Credentials found in checked material
patterns.generalFixRule: Name category and location in the deliverable, never the value.
